note: Published results withdrawn after publication, with the reason and the way back. A run that happened is not deleted: the file it wrote stays as the record, and this file says which of its rows can no longer be read as a measurement.

entries.reason: The passages handed to the cross-encoder were built as one entry per event uid over 2 046 chunks, so for every event the splitter had cut -- about half the corpus -- only the last chunk survived, usually the block carrying dates and prices. The 0.55 recall@1 measured that preparation, not reranking.
entries.fixed_by: events_rag.evaluation.ablation.passages_by_uid reassembles the chunks of an event before scoring; tests/unit/test_ablation.py checks that a two-chunk event reaches the scorer with its title.
